summary.intent: Resolve open PR review comments from automated reviewers (GitHub Copilot) identifying bugs in the E2E fallback logic in release-gate.yml.
summary.outcome: Fixed two fallback loops to require all runs to succeed (`SUCCESS == TOTAL`) instead of accepting partial passes, removed unused `FAILED` variable, fixed bash subshell scoping issue with process substitution, committed and pushed, replied to and resolved both review threads.

repo: release-gate.yml contains fallback loops that search older CI runs when the latest run is missing — these loops previously accepted partial successes, masking regressions
The fallback logic is meant to be authoritative: the first run that actually executed E2E jobs should be the final verdict, not just any run with at least one success

code.finding: Fallback loops used `SUCCESS > 0 && FAILED == 0` which allowed partial runs (some jobs skipped) to pass the gate; replaced with `SUCCESS == TOTAL` to require all jobs ran and passed

Loop was piped via `| while read`, creating a subshell where `exit 1` only exits the subshell and does not propagate to the step; fixed by switching to process substitution `while read ... < <(...)` so the loop runs in the main shell

workflow: GitHub Copilot automated reviewer can flag meaningful logic bugs in CI YAML, not just style issues
When resolving PR threads: reply via REST API using `--field in_reply_to=COMMENT_ID` (integer), resolve via GraphQL `resolveReviewThread` mutation
Bash piped while loops run in subshells — `exit 1` inside them won't fail the outer script; process substitution is the correct fix

friction: The subshell scoping bug in the piped while loop required a non-obvious fix (process substitution) that wasn't immediately apparent from the original code
